ios.desc:
Listen to streaming internet radio in an award-winning, ultra-simple, single-purpose app. Beautifully designed and fully-native on all platforms. Completely private: no accounts, no logins, and absolutely no tracking or analytics, by design.

Broadcasts makes building a library of stations from around the world easier than ever. Use completely free with a handful of stations, or subscribe to unlock the full power of an unlimited library and add as many of your own stations as you like from the thousands available on the Station Browser, or manually via URL. Search for stations from around the world as easily as from your own library, by country, by genre, or on the world map. Manually add and listen to your favorite live podcasts, air traffic control, and more — just point Broadcasts at any supported streaming audio source. Use the Now Playing screen to showcase gorgeous station and track artwork (where provided). Control from the MiniPlayer, or the menu bar on your Mac. Use Broadcasts in StandBy mode on your iPhone as a bedside clock.

Sync your library across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple Vision Pro, and Apple TV with iCloud, and Universal Purchase. Enjoy your library on the road using CarPlay and your iPhone. Listen with just your Apple Watch (Cellular) while on a run, or on Apple TV at home.

Browse stations in grid or list view. Listen in Light or Dark mode. Edit stations to provide your own artwork, or use the Artwork Chooser or Image Playground to generate something fun and colorful. Use Handoff to transfer playback between devices, or AirPlay directly to a home speaker.

Live Transcription uses an advanced on-device model to provide a realtime transcript so you can follow along without audio, or scroll back and see what you just missed, with support for dozens of languages. On macOS, Siri AI lets you ask questions about the transcript, like 'who is this person' or 'translate this for me'.

Use Shazam to look up the current song, and add it to your music library.

Supports Shortcuts & AppleScript for playback automation. Sleep Timer. Visualizer. Widgets. Spotlight. Siri. Game Controller. And much more!

Supports Family Sharing.

Made in Ireland.

quotes.text:
Blog with demo video:

https://spencerdailey.com/2020/05/07/how-to-give-each-of-your-macs-spaces-a-custom-sound/

Hello there,

After ~2 years of solo-developing CurrentKey Stats, which lets you assign persistent names to Spaces on macOS - I've pushed an update that extends its functionality out of the sandbox. A decent way to demo this was with Broadcasts (an app by indie dev https://twitter.com/stroughtonsmith), which has AppleScript support.

So, as you move between your Spaces (the app calls them Rooms), any number of custom events can be triggered. So you could... turn on Dark Mode for your "Coding" Room only, or... always Mute volume when you move into your "Reading" Room, etc.

For my purposes, the macOS sandbox was not too limiting, as long as the user moves an AppleScript into the app's Scripts folder (which I provide a shortcut for), all the power is there without limitations.

I'd love to hear any and all feedback -- most of the features in the app that have shipped since launch are by request.

Thanks everyone!

CurrentKey free on the Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1456226992?pt=119982183&ct=hn&mt=8

Featured app, Broadcasts: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/broadcasts/id1469995354
